mapper.select: SELECT t1.CORP_GR AS corpGr , t1.COMPANY_NAME AS companyName , TO_CHAR(t1.HYUN_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS hyunYmd , TO_CHAR(t1.GIJUNGA_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS gijungaYmd , TO_CHAR(t1.JUNYONG_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS junyongYmd , TO_CHAR(t1.IKYONG_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ikyongYmd , TO_CHAR(t1.THIKYONG_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS thikyongYmd , TO_CHAR(t1.SYMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS symd , TO_CHAR(t1.EYMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS eymd , t1.DEPOSIT_DD AS depositDd , t1.DEPOSIT_ACCOUNT AS depositAccount , t1.BIGO AS bigo , t1.CUSTOMER_GR AS customerGr , t1.EXPENSE_YN AS expenseYn , 1 AS pVisible FROM SZX0AA t1 ORDER BY t1.CORP_GR ASC

SELECT t1.CORP_GR AS corpGr , TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , t1.COMPANY_NAME AS companyName , t1.IDNO AS idno , TO_CHAR(t1.CONTRACT_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS contractYmd , t1.POST AS post , t1.JUSO AS juso , t1.CEO_NM AS ceoNm , t1.TEL_NO AS telNo , t1.FAX_NO AS faxNo , t1.E_MAIL AS email , 1 AS pVisible FROM SZX0AB t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} ORDER BY t1.YMD DESC
